title: Unauthorized Registration
description: Homeowner (EE1) registers an account without verifying the identity of the Home Hub (P1) or confirming the legitimacy of the registration request.

title: Inappropriate Data Collection
description: Homeowner (EE1) enrolls cameras/sensors on the Home Hub (P1) without explicit, informed consent from the homeowner.

title: Non-Compliance with Privacy Policy
description: Homeowner (EE1) enrolls cameras/sensors on the Home Hub (P1) without reading or agreeing to the Home Hub's privacy policy.

title: Data Leakage
description: Homeowner (EE1) enrolls cameras/sensors on the Home Hub (P1) without securing the data, potentially exposing personal information.

title: Data Duplication
description: Homeowner (EE1) enrolls cameras/sensors on the Home Hub (P1) without ensuring the data is not duplicated or shared with unauthorized parties.

title: Unintended Data Use
description: Homeowner (EE1) enrolls cameras/sensors on the Home Hub (P1) without understanding how the data will be used or stored.

title: Non-Compliance with Consent
description: Homeowner (EE1) enrolls cameras/sensors on the Home Hub (P1) without obtaining valid consent for the specific data collection.

title: Unauthorized Access Attempt
description: Guest User (EE2) enters a temporary access code at the Home Hub (P1) to unlock the front door. This action is a direct attempt to gain unauthorized physical access to the facility.

title: Information Disclosure
description: The Home Hub (P1) processes the guest's access code and may disclose this information to other systems or personnel without proper authorization.

title: Non-Compliance with Privacy Policy
description: The guest's use of the temporary access code may violate the organization's privacy policy regarding guest data handling.

title: Data Collection
description: The Home Hub (P1) collects the guest's access code, which is personal data that should be handled according to privacy regulations.

title: Data Dissemination
description: The guest's access code is disseminated to the Home Hub (P1) for processing, which may lead to unauthorized sharing.

title: User Error
description: The guest may enter an incorrect or invalid access code, leading to a failed attempt at unlocking the door.

title: Non-Compliance with Law
description: The guest's use of the temporary access code may violate local laws or regulations regarding guest privacy.

title: Unauthorized Access to Home Hub
description: An attacker could potentially access the Home Hub (P1) to read sensitive data or manipulate the data flow.

title: Information Disclosure
description: The Home Hub (P1) may disclose sensitive motion/door/sensor data to unauthorized parties.

title: Non-Repudiation
description: The Home Hub (P1) may not be able to prove the origin of the data or deny actions taken.

title: Data Integrity
description: The Home Hub (P1) may alter or corrupt the data written to the Local Event Log (DS1).

title: Data Destruction
description: The Home Hub (P1) may delete or destroy the data written to the Local Event Log (DS1).

title: Unintended Consequences
description: The Home Hub (P1) may cause unintended side effects on the Local Event Log (DS1) or the system.

title: Unauthorized Access to Local Event Log
description: An attacker could potentially access the Local Event Log (DS1) to read sensitive data.

title: Information Disclosure
description: The Local Event Log (DS1) may disclose sensitive motion/door/sensor data to unauthorized parties.

title: Non-Repudiation
description: The Local Event Log (DS1) may not be able to prove the origin of the data or deny actions taken.

title: Data Integrity
description: The Local Event Log (DS1) may alter or corrupt the data written by the Home Hub.

title: Data Destruction
description: The Local Event Log (DS1) may delete or destroy the data written by the Home Hub.

title: Unintended Consequences
description: The Local Event Log (DS1) may cause unintended side effects on the Home Hub or the system.

title: Unauthorized Access to Uploaded Media
description: A user or malicious actor could access the camera clips stored in the Home Hub without authorization, potentially violating privacy policies.
assumptions: The Home Hub has a mechanism to store media but lacks explicit encryption or access controls.

title: Data Leakage via Unencrypted Transmission
description: Uploaded camera clips may be transmitted to the Cloud Video Storage in an unencrypted format, exposing sensitive user data.
assumptions: The system does not explicitly state that data is encrypted during transfer.

title: Data Inconsistency in Storage
description: The Cloud Video Storage might not accurately reflect the content of the Home Hub, leading to discrepancies in data availability.
assumptions: The system does not explicitly state that the storage is a direct, real-time mirror of the Hub.

title: Unauthorized Access to Home Hub Data
description: An attacker could potentially access the internal data stored in the Home Hub (Process P1) without authorization, potentially including sensitive user information or system configurations.

title: Information Disclosure
description: Data from the Home Hub (Process P1) could be disclosed to unauthorized parties, such as through network breaches or internal misconfigurations.

title: Non-Repudiation
description: The Home Hub (Process P1) might not be able to prove the origin of a specific data packet or action, potentially leading to disputes about data integrity.

title: Denial of Service
description: An attacker could exploit the Home Hub (Process P1) to cause a denial of service, making it unavailable to legitimate users.

title: Data Duplication
description: Data from the Home Hub (Process P1) could be duplicated and sent to unauthorized destinations, potentially leading to data leakage.

title: Unintended Consequences
description: The Home Hub (Process P1) might be used in ways not intended by the system, leading to unexpected data exposure or system instability.

title: Non-Compliance
description: The Home Hub (Process P1) might not comply with relevant privacy regulations or standards, leading to non-compliance issues.

title: Unauthorized Access to Sensitive Data
description: The mobile app backend (P2) has the capability to access and potentially expose sensitive user data (e.g., location history, health metrics) without explicit user consent or a secure, encrypted channel.

title: Data Leakage via Unencrypted Transmission
description: The notification is pushed to the homeowner's phone via an unencrypted channel, which could allow interception of the data payload.

title: User Consent and Awareness
description: The homeowner (EE1) may not be aware that their motion-detected data is being transmitted to the mobile app backend, or may not understand the implications of sharing this data.
uncertainty_note: The homeowner's awareness of data sharing is a key factor. Without explicit consent or clear communication, this is a significant privacy risk.

title: Identity Disclosure
description: The homeowner's identity is being disclosed to the mobile app backend, which could be used for targeted advertising or profiling.

title: Data Aggregation
description: The mobile app backend aggregates device-usage data from multiple sources into a single dataset before sharing it with the cloud vendor.
assumptions: The aggregation process is performed locally on the backend server and does not involve any external data sources.

title: Data Exfiltration
description: The aggregated analytics dataset is transmitted over an unencrypted channel to the external vendor.
assumptions: The transmission protocol is not specified, but the context implies a direct transfer of the full dataset.

title: Data Access
description: The cloud analytics vendor has access to the aggregated device-usage data.
assumptions: The vendor's access is based on a contract that grants them read access to the analytics dataset.

title: Data Disclosure
description: The vendor may disclose the aggregated device-usage data to third parties or for their own analytics purposes.
assumptions: The vendor's internal policies and the scope of their analytics use are not specified.

title: Unauthorized Access to Video Clip
description: A malicious actor with access to the video storage (DS2) could retrieve a specific video clip intended for the homeowner without authorization.
assumptions: The video clip is stored in a secure location accessible to the data store.

title: Data Exfiltration
description: The data store (DS2) could be compromised or accessed by an unauthorized party, allowing the extraction of the video clip.
assumptions: The data store is not protected by sufficient security measures.

title: Unauthorized Playback
description: The mobile app backend (P2) could be exploited to play a video clip that was not intended for the homeowner.
assumptions: The mobile app has access to the video clip and could play it.

title: Data Exfiltration
description: The mobile app backend (P2) could be exploited to play a video clip that was not intended for the homeowner, potentially leading to data leakage.
assumptions: The mobile app has access to the video clip and could play it.
